summary: Can-Fite BioPharma filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 12, 2026 press release on preclinical piclidenoson data in Lowe syndrome, published in Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy, a Nature Portfolio journal. The item is a routine clinical/scientific disclosure, not a special situation. No ownership stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, financing mechanic, regulatory clock or transaction structure is present. The registrant files as a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K. What to watch: Italian Phase II authorization timing, not deal risk-arb.
